hear-and-use-definite-articles.label: Hear and Use Definite Articles
hear-and-use-definite-articles.summary: Mix all five singular definite article forms in listening, speaking, building, and writing.

try_hear_and_use_definite_articles_sketc.title: Try it yourself: Hear a mixed article phrase
try_hear_and_use_definite_articles_sketc.prompt: Right after the sketch "Hear the end of the noun", practice that exact idea with this task. Listen, then build the noun phrase you hear. Produce the result for hear a mixed article phrase so it reinforces Hear and Use Definite Articles.

listen-ending.title: Hear the end of the noun
listen-ending.bodyMarkdown: You already know the article follows the noun. In this course, pause on the noun ending before choosing among **a, la, an, lan,** and **nan**. The practice list gives mixed forms such as **radyo a**, **valiz la**, **televizyon an**, and **telefòn nan**.

keep-known-order.title: Keep the noun first
keep-known-order.bodyMarkdown: Course 1 already established the word order: noun first, definite article after it. Do not relearn that rule here. Use the known order while concentrating on which article form fits the noun.

mixed-confidence.title: Choose the form, not an English translation
mixed-confidence.bodyMarkdown: The English word “the” stays the same, but Kreyòl changes the singular article form. Let the Kreyòl noun guide the choice. Practice switching forms without turning the activity into a vocabulary restart.
